With the widespread application of visual systems such as intelligent security surveillance and autonomous driving in low-illumination environments, low-light image processing technology has become a key support for breaking through the bottleneck of environmental perception. Images acquired under low-illumination conditions often suffer from low brightness, obvious noise, and color distortion. This project aims to achieve effective enhancement of images in

low-light scenarios, so as to suppress noise and meanwhile significantly improve the overall image quality.It performs effective enhancement for images captured under low-illumination conditions, improves image brightness, and reduces the noise level.

  1.  Collect and organize the corresponding datasets, including public datasets and self-built datasets.
  2. Reproduce the basic algorithms, test the influence of various parameters, and evaluate the restoration performance under different scenarios
rows.themeTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-Light Image Enhancement

1.A strong interest in cooperative path planning of multi-UAVs

2.Fundamentals of machine learning and reinforcement learning

3.Python programming language
rows.themeProjectDescription:
The main task of this thesis is to conduct research and simulation on multi-UAV cooperative path planning based on deep reinforcement learning. Students shall complete the following major tasks in this graduation project:

  1. Investigate the research status of multi-UAV cooperative path planning, including traditional algorithms and reinforcement learning-based methods. Sort out the research progress of deep reinforcement learning applied in path planning and swarm intelligence, and clarify the research difficulties and technical challenges.
  2. Learn and master the basic theories, relevant tools and application scenarios of deep reinforcement learning.
  3. Establish a mathematical model for multi-UAV cooperative path planning, including UAV kinematic constraints, task area modeling, obstacle constraints, and cooperative objective functions (such as shortest path, obstacle avoidance and collision avoidance). Clarify the design ideas of state space, action space and reward function.
  4. Design a cooperative path planning method suitable for multi-UAVs based on the deep reinforcement learning framework.
  5. Learn and master simulation platforms such as Gazebo, AirSim and PyBullet.
  6. Carry out experimental verification, compare the performance differences between traditional methods and deep reinforcement learning methods, and highlight the advantages of reinforcement learning in UAV cooperative path planning.
rows.themeTitle: Research on multi-UAV cooperative path planning based on deep reinforcement learning

rows.themeProjectDescription:
The main task of this thesis is to conduct research and simulation on cooperative safe path planning for multi-UAVs based on deep reinforcement learning. Students are required to complete the following major tasks in this graduation project:

  1. Understand the limitations of traditional algorithms in solving multi-UAV motion planning, review the state-of-the-art of path planning and obstacle avoidance technologies for multi-intelligent UAVs, and demonstrate the advantages of deep reinforcement learning in dealing with uncertain and dynamic environments.
  2. Study the safety issues of multi-UAVs in dynamic and complex environments (such as collision and obstacle avoidance) as well as their corresponding solutions.
  3. Learn and master the basic theories, relevant tools and application scenarios of deep reinforcement learning.
  4. Investigate deep reinforcement learning algorithms applied in the field of intelligent UAV path planning and obstacle avoidance. Design and construct simulation verification scenarios and constraint conditions, and establish corresponding mathematical models and objective functions.
  5. Learn and master software platforms including OpenAI MPE, Unity, PyBullet and MATLAB, and build a multi-UAV simulation environment based on these platforms.
  6. Conduct algorithm verification and performance comparison. Compare the existing path planning and obstacle avoidance algorithms with the proposed deep reinforcement learning algorithm, and highlight the advantages of the improved algorithm in multi-UAV coordination, especially its optimization effects in dynamic obstacle avoidance, safety guarantee and task success rate.
rows.themeTitle: Research on Cooperative Safe Path Planning for Multi-UAVs Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning

rows.themeProjectDescription:
The main task of this thesis is to conduct research and simulation on gait control of quadruped robots based on deep reinforcement learning. During the graduation design, students are required to complete the following major tasks:

  1. Systematically review the research progress of gait control methods for quadruped robots at home and abroad, with a focus on the application of reinforcement learning, deep learning and simulation platforms in robot motion control. Summarize the advantages and deficiencies of existing researches, so as to provide theoretical and technical support for the research direction of this thesis.
  2. Learn and master the basic theories, relevant tools and application scenarios of deep reinforcement learning.
  3. Establish the dynamic modeling and simulation environment suitable for quadruped robots. Design a gait control strategy based on mainstream deep reinforcement learning algorithms to realize the learning and optimization of stable robot gaits. In addition, design and construct simulation verification scenarios and constraint conditions, and establish mathematical models and objective functions.
  4. Learn and master simulation platforms such as PyBullet and MuJoCo.
  5. Carry out experimental verification, compare the performance differences between traditional control methods and deep reinforcement learning control methods, and highlight the advantages of reinforcement learning in the gait control of quadruped robots.

rows.themePrerequisiteSkills:
• Solid foundation in digital signal processing and matrix theory
  • Knowledge of array signal processing and beamforming techniques
  • Familiarity with convex optimization and numerical optimization methods (e.g., CVX, gradient-based algorithms)
  • Basic understanding of MIMO communication systems and radar sensing principles
  • Proficiency in MATLAB/Python for algorithm implementation and simulation
rows.themeProjectDescription:
1. Background

Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) has emerged as a key enabling technology for next-generation wireless networks (e.g., 6G), where the same hardware and spectrum resources are shared to perform both high-data-rate communication and high-resolution sensing (e.g., target detection, localization, and imaging). Hybrid beamforming, which combines a low-dimensional digital precoder with an analog phase-shifter network, offers a cost- and energy-efficient solution for large-scale MIMO systems. However, designing hybrid beamforming for ISAC systems faces challenges: the beamformer must simultaneously satisfy communication metrics (e.g., spectral efficiency, SINR) and sensing requirements (e.g., beampattern matching, Cramér–Rao bound). Most existing works treat the two functions separately or rely on fully digital architectures. This project aims to develop novel hybrid beamforming algorithms that jointly optimize both functionalities under hardware constraints.


2. Main Task

  • Literature review: Survey state-of-the-art hybrid beamforming designs for ISAC, identify research gaps (e.g., limited work on dynamic sensing-communication trade-off, phase shifter quantization effects).
  • System modeling: Establish a system model for a downlink ISAC transceiver with a partially connected or fully connected hybrid architecture. Define key performance indicators: achievable sum-rate for communication and beampattern matching error/clutter suppression for sensing.
  • Algorithm design:
  • Formulate a multi-objective optimization problem balancing communication and sensing metrics.
  • Propose an iterative algorithm based on alternating minimization or manifold optimization to solve the hybrid precoder/combiner.
  • Optionally, integrate deep unfolding or reinforcement learning for low-latency adaptation.
  • Simulation and analysis: Implement the proposed algorithm in MATLAB.


3. Expected Outcomes

  • A well-documented MATLAB code package and a final report (40–50 pages) summarizing the methodology, results, and future work.
rows.themeTitle: Research on Hybrid Beamforming Design Algorithm for Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) Systems

rows.themeProjectDescription:
Aluminum plate will produce defects in the process of processing and use. Ultrasonic guided wave is an effective method for defect detection of aluminum plate r. In this project, the RAPID imaging algorithm used to recognize the defect contour of aluminum plate ultrasonic image.


The main task of the project are as follows:


1) Analysis of domestic and international technological status;


2) Learning about ultrasound guided wave related knowledge;


3) Ultrasound guided wave defects detection experiment in aluminum plate;


4) RAPID imaging reconstruction of defect images;


5) Edge extraction identifies defects.


 The expected outcomes are defect identification in aluminum plate based on RAPID imaging algorithm.
rows.themeTitle: Ultrasonic Guided Wave Imaging for Defects in Aluminum Plate

rows.themeProjectDescription:
With the development of network technology, home networks such as WiFi can not only connect family members' devices to the Internet, but also let these devices control some household appliances. The project aims to design a mobile app that can control fan in WiFi environment. The system environment in the project is Android, because Android is now used by most smartphones, and there are very mature supporting tools to help developers develop Android apps, such as Android Studio and Genymotion. The technologies used in this project include Java language, WiFi communication, automation control, etc.


The main task of the project are as follows:

1. Refer to WiFi communication and Android programming related materials, and learn relevant software and hardware knowledge.

2. The overall design of the smart mobile phone remote control fan system.

3. Hardware design of the smart mobile phone remote control fan system. 

4. Software design of the smart mobile phone remote control fan system. 

5. System debugging of the smart mobile phone remote control fan system. 


The expected outcomes are hardware and software.

Software: the code of fan control app based on Android, and the code of main control of fan.

Hardware: fan and circuit components.
rows.themeTitle: Design and Implementation of Smart Mobile Phone Remote Control Fan System

rows.themePrerequisiteSkills: Proficiency in C++ (for ultrasonic board code development), familiarity with Python (PyTorch) (for agent training), and capability in MATLAB for signal processing.
rows.themeProjectDescription:
In modern industrial non-destructive testing (NDT), the accuracy of ultrasonic testing is constrained by the complex parameter combinations of the transmitting board. There exists a highly nonlinear coupling relationship among transmitting parameters such as Voltage, Frequency, Pulse Width, and Gate, Filtering, Backwall Echo, as well as Defect Echo. Conventional fixed-parameter testing methods struggle to cope with signal attenuation and noise interference under complex working conditions (e.g., small-diameter pipes, saddle-shaped welds).

This project aims to establish a mathematical model between the ultrasonic sound field and board parameters, and introduce the Spacetime Echo Potential (STEP) field theory to characterize the acoustic environment. Based on real-time acquired echo data, an intelligent control Agent employing an Actor-Critic architecture will be trained. The agent can dynamically optimize the transmitting board parameters according to the real-time feedback of echo signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and waveform characteristics, thereby achieving accurate defect identification and intelligent compensation, meeting the high demands for automation and intelligence in NDT for high-end manufacturing.
rows.themeTitle: Research and Development of an Intelligent Control Agent for Multi-channel Ultrasonic Testing System
